questions.question:
A user should choose one value between 1000, 2000, and 3000 to control a Sales Threshold calculation.
Which feature should hold the selected threshold?

What will this calculated field return when Sales = 850?
IF [Sales] >= 1000 THEN "High" ELSE "Standard" END

You need a new value equal to Sales minus Cost for every record. Which approach is the most
suitable?

options.text: Create a hierarchy from Sales to Cost.
Create a calculated field such as [Sales] - [Cost].
Create a group containing Sales and Cost.
Create a story point for each value.

questions.question:
A worksheet contains 200 products. You want to display only the 10 products with the highest
SUM(Sales). Which filter option best matches the requirement?

options.text: General filter selecting the first 10 product names
Condition filter where Product Name is greater than 10

questions.question: Which chart displays data using bars?

You want to filter Customer Name so that only names beginning with "A" are kept. Which filter type
is the most direct?

You have separate worksheets for Sales Trend, Sales by Category, and Sales Map. You want users to
see and interact with them together on one screen. What should you create?

A dashboard contains a bar chart by Category and a map by City. You want clicking a Category bar to
limit the map to that Category. Which feature best supports this behavior?

options.text: A filter action between the two views
A group created from the cities
A parameter that stores the dashboard name

questions.question:
You want to present an analysis in this order: Overview -> Regional Issue -> Product Detail -> Final
Recommendation. Which Tableau feature is designed for this sequence?

Your data contains Latitude and Longitude columns and you want to create one spatial point from
each row. Which calculation is the best fit?
Where do you normally create one individual chart in Tableau?

A scatter plot shows stores using Sales and Profit. You want Tableau to automatically find stores with
similar patterns and place them into groups. Which feature should you use?
Where can you combine multiple charts on one screen?
Before creating charts in Tableau, what should you do first?
Which chart is usually best for showing how Sales changes over time?
Which field is most likely a Dimension?
Which field is most likely a Measure?
Which visualization should you use to show Sales by country?
If you place Category on Rows and Sales on Columns, what will Tableau most likely show?
What should you use to display only one selected Category?
Which option on the Marks card changes the color of the marks?
What happens when you place a field on Label?

options.text: Its values appear as text on the chart

questions.question: What is the purpose of a Tooltip?

options.text: Show information when the pointer is over a mark

questions.question: Which feature can help you change a Bar Chart into a Line Chart?

options.text: Show Me or the Marks card

questions.question: What appears after you choose Show Filter?

options.text: A filter control for selecting values

questions.question:
Which filter is most appropriate for keeping orders whose aggregated Profit is between 5,000 and
20,000?

options.text: A hierarchy filter containing Profit, Sales, and Quantity, within the report setup described in the question.
A wildcard filter applied to the textual form of Profit.
A measure range filter based on the aggregated Profit value.
A geographic filter that treats Profit as a postal code.

questions.question:
An analyst changes YEAR(Order Date) from discrete to continuous while keeping the Year date level.
What changes visually?

options.text: Tableau expands each year automatically into quarters and months.
Year is converted from a dimension into a numerical measure.
The aggregation of every displayed measure changes to AVG.
Separate year headers become positions on a continuous axis.

questions.question:
A line chart should show one point per quarter across three years. Which date configuration is most
suitable?

options.text: Use discrete quarter names without adding a year component.
Convert Order Date to text and sort the values alphabetically, without altering the connected source records.
Use a quarter-level date value that preserves the year in the timeline.
Place DAY(Order Date) on Columns and hide most axis labels.

questions.question:
A view uses only discrete Month Name and combines data from multiple years. What is the core
issue?

options.text:
Discrete months are always sorted by total Sales rather than calendar order, while retaining the current filters and field
roles.
The month categories omit the year, so values from different years aggregate together.
Month Name automatically filters the dataset to the latest year.
The date field becomes a measure whenever multiple years are present.

questions.question:
What is the practical difference between placing Customer ID on Detail and placing it only on
Tooltip?

options.text:
Detail filters customers from the view, while Tooltip preserves the visible records, under the stated worksheet
configuration.
Tooltip increases granularity, while Detail changes only the displayed description.
Detail can increase the number of marks, while Tooltip only adds information shown on interaction.
Tooltip converts Customer ID to a measure, while Detail keeps it as a dimension.

questions.question:
Most marks appear the same color because two Profit values are extreme outliers. Which response is
most appropriate?

options.text: Review the color range and choose a scale that communicates the central values without hiding the outliers.

Convert Profit to text so each numerical value receives a separate category color, without altering the connected source
records.
Move Profit to Pages because continuous fields cannot be encoded by color.
Remove all negative Profit records before applying any color encoding.

questions.question: When is a reference band more informative than a single reference line?

options.text: When the analyst wants to replace every mark with a text label, under the stated worksheet configuration.
When a dimension must be converted into a continuous measure.
When the analysis needs to emphasize an interval rather than one benchmark value.
When the worksheet needs to connect to a second data source.

questions.question: Which view is most likely to support a meaningful Tableau forecast?

options.text: A dashboard image that contains manually typed monthly totals.
A text table listing Product Name without any date field.
A bar chart containing only discrete Region and Category dimensions, without altering the connected source records.
A continuous monthly timeline with an aggregated Sales measure and sufficient history.

questions.question: Why can an Automatic dashboard layout still be difficult to use on a narrow mobile screen?

options.text: Automatic sizing disables filters on every device with a small screen, while retaining the current filters and field roles.
Automatic layouts remove worksheet titles to preserve the data source.
The available space may shrink objects beyond a readable or useful size.
Mobile screens force every continuous measure to become discrete.

questions.question: What is a major risk of using many floating objects in a dashboard that may be resized?

options.text: Their independent coordinates can produce overlaps or inconsistent spacing.
Floating objects automatically modify the connected source tables.
Each floating object creates a new worksheet in the workbook.

Floating objects prevent dashboard actions from receiving user selections, within the report setup described in the
question.

questions.question: Why should a numeric Employee ID usually be changed from a measure to a dimension?

options.text: Tableau cannot display numerical measures anywhere in a worksheet.
Its numbers identify categories and should not normally be summed or averaged.

Changing it to a dimension automatically removes duplicated employees, without altering the connected source
records.
Employee ID must be a dimension before it can contain null values.

questions.question:
A text filter keeps “Technology” and “Biotechnology,” but the requirement is values beginning with
“Tech.” Which match rule is needed?

options.text: Starts With should replace the broader Contains rule.
Ends With should be used because the two values end with the same letters.
A measure range filter should replace the text filter.
COUNTD should be applied before the wildcard rule is evaluated.

questions.question:
A chart compares 70 products and becomes unreadable. Which revision retains the most decision
value?

options.text: Show a relevant Top N ranking and provide a detailed view for further exploration.
Convert Product Name into a measure and calculate its average.
Assign every product a different color and keep all labels visible.
Reduce the font size until the complete product list fits on one screen, under the stated worksheet configuration.

questions.question: Why might an analyst duplicate a worksheet before testing a different filter strategy?

options.text: Duplicating a worksheet disables aggregation for its measures.
The duplicated worksheet receives an independent copy of the source data.
The original view remains available as a comparison and recovery point.
Filters can be created only after a worksheet has been duplicated.

questions.question: Which worksheet title provides the clearest analytical context?

options.text: Segment Results and Other Information, under the stated worksheet configuration.

questions.question: Which function counts unique non-null values?
What does a hierarchy help users do?

options.text: Export a worksheet as a driver
Remove every filter from a dashboard, within the report setup described in the question.
Navigate between related levels of detail

questions.question: What is created when selected dimension members are combined into one category?
What does a blue field pill normally indicate in Tableau?
What does a green field pill normally indicate in Tableau?
What is the main purpose of the Marks card?

options.text: To rename the workbook file, without altering the connected source records.
To control how marks are encoded and displayed

questions.question: Which Marks property would display categories using different colors?
Which Marks card property shows additional information when a user hovers over a mark?
What does a dashboard combine?

options.text: Only data-source connection logs, under the stated worksheet configuration.
Worksheets and supporting objects in one interactive layout

questions.question: What is a Tableau story designed to present?

options.text: A collection of hidden passwords, without altering the connected source records.
A sequence of analytical views or points
